title: The Ultimate Café Opening Checklist: A Complete Pre-Launch Guide

facts.fact: The TGP International guide states that a significant percentage of cafés fail within their first 12–24 months, without giving a specific percentage.
facts.quote: Globally, a significant percentage of cafés fail within their first 12–24 months.

facts.fact: The TGP International café opening checklist guide was published on 19 February 2026.
The TGP International guide says delays in licensing and compliance can postpone a café opening by weeks or months, without giving a specific figure.
facts.quote: Delays in compliance can postpone opening by weeks, or months.

facts.fact: The page recommends a phased opening strategy that includes a soft launch, friends and family events, and press events.
facts.quote: A phased opening strategy (soft launch, friends & family, press events)

facts.fact: The page lists a reservation strategy to manage demand as part of launch planning.

The page lists seven final steps to complete before opening, including full operational testing, menu tastings, mock service sessions, equipment calibration, staff rehearsals, health inspection readiness, and opening-day staffing plans.
facts.quote: execute these final steps of your coffee shop pre opening checklist:

facts.fact: The page says post-opening performance should be tracked on sales, speed of service, wastage, and customer feedback.
TGP International states that most café issues are operational rather than aesthetic.
facts.quote: Most café issues are operational, not aesthetic

facts.fact: The page lists underestimating staffing costs as a common mistake when starting a coffee shop.
The page lists a Google Maps listing, delivery platforms, and website basics as digital presence items for launch.
The page lists limited-time promotions and loyalty programs as launch offers.
